items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to instruct Aaron to stretch out his rod and strike the dust of Egypt.
